title: odd-side-nav
description: Side navigation: links, actions, and expandable groups from `.items` (or native links in the default slot), arranged by the `side-nav` layout recipe, which responds to the element's own width with container queries only.
$comment: Slots: default, "footer", "header". A child names a slot with "slot"; text and children without "slot" go to the default slot.

label.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark, e.g. "Primary".

current.description: Id of the current link; it gets `aria-current="page"`.

items.description: Entries. When set (even to an empty array) it is the only source; slotted entries are not rendered.

expanded.description: Ids of expanded groups, owned by the caller. Omit it to let the element track expansion.
